prompt:
Create ONE original human DEFENDER / SHIELDBEARER game character sprite on a truly transparent background. The attached image is ONLY a reference for the board camera angle, palette mood and scale; do not reproduce the board, text or tiles. Design direction: a restrained mixture of Warcraft's chunky heroic silhouettes and Kingdom Rush's charming clear cartoon shapes. My variant is a squat sturdy veteran guard, broad compact torso, slightly oversized head, a simple rounded open-face steel helmet with a very small brow ridge, visible determined face and short dark beard, large clean shoulder armor planes, sturdy short boots. Wears desaturated slate-steel plate armor, warm muted ochre tabard, brown leather gloves and belt. In his LEFT arm a very large broad simple heater shield with beveled thick steel rim and muted burgundy painted central panel; in his RIGHT hand a short broad steel sword held low and outwards. The shield clearly identifies the class. No logos, spikes, feathers, horns, glowing magic, elaborate engravings or tiny decorative noise. Strong readable silhouette and large quiet color planes.
CRITICAL CAMERA: this is a SOLID VOLUMETRIC MINIATURE seen from ABOVE at an orthographic dimetric/isometric camera compatible with a 2:1 diamond board. Not a flat paper standee, not front view, not a portrait, not side-scroller art. Character faces screen lower-right/southeast at 45 degrees. Clearly visible helmet TOP, TOP of both shoulder pads, upper shield rim and boot insteps. Foreshorten the torso/legs appropriately; near shoulder/boot sit lower in the image than the far shoulder/boot. Consistent soft upper-left light with only 2-3 strong discrete shade planes per material, no gradients.
PIXEL ART: coarse controlled pixel grid, about 64x64 logical sprite resolution, clean coherent square pixel clusters, no anti-aliasing, no textured brushwork, no dithering. Keep detail readable when the figure is only about 90 screen pixels high. One whole character, centered, all equipment and both feet fully visible with ample transparent padding. Transparent all around and BETWEEN feet. No base, NO floor, NO shadow, no platform, no props, no text. Make him feel grounded by pose alone.
note: User explicitly invited own variants after requesting PixelLab.
